method: Five agents received fresh contexts, different model overrides, identical high reasoning requests, and the same dispatch text except for assigned output folder. Each was required to read the frozen common brief and 19 input files, and forbidden to inspect other participant outputs. Each authored and revised its own three concepts using the common renderer. Model-specific coordinator feedback and unequal image-inspection access make these revised pilot examples unsuitable for a controlled model ranking. The original three and added two were dispatched in separate batches. No scores or winners are assigned.
